findings.title: imperative commands cognition instead of penal action
findings.claim: The plural imperative iʿlamū makes knowledge the addressees' required response to the exception.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:34:9:2 governs the following content clause; the exception and prospective power boundary trigger it, changing the discourse from possible penal action to required cognition of the divine characterization.
findings.reader_payoff: The addressed community is seen registering the condition under which it must act.
findings.containment: The command remains a command to know and does not itself erase the ruling.

epistemic.reason: Trusted imperative and clausal-object evidence directly support the relation.

findings.title: know-that formula belongs to legal instruction
findings.claim: The know-that construction places the mercy assertion inside a legal instruction.
findings.mechanism: The imperative and anna-content pattern meet the exception boundary, so the attribute clause functions as specified legal knowledge rather than an unrelated devotional afterthought.
findings.reader_payoff: The final command is perceived as instruction shaped by the case just stated.
findings.containment: The formula colors the instruction's role without replacing the ordinary command to know.

epistemic.reason: The command-family evidence is supplied and locally constrained by the object clause.

findings.title: knowledge has marking and recognition force
findings.claim: The knowledge command also makes the exception a boundary that must be recognized.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:34:9:2 meets the connected exception and power threshold at 5:34:1:1 and 5:34:7:1; the supplied marking field changes knowing from passive information into registering the distinction that governs action.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive knowledge as the act that marks the legal boundary in the addressees' judgment.
findings.containment: The sign resonance remains a bounded recognition image and does not turn the command into a literal sign.

epistemic.reason: The root-payoff support and focus relation activate a bounded recognition reading.

findings.title: pivot contrasts human power with divine attributes

findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:34:9:1 transitions from the second-person authority event to Allah's predicate content; human power becomes the preceding condition and divine mercy the interpretive frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause move from authority's reach to the character of the one under whose knowledge it acts.
findings.containment: The contrast is relational and does not rank or replace either clause.

epistemic.reason: Trusted transition evidence supports the role contrast while preserving both local clauses.

findings.title: base_precontrol_exception
findings.claim: The attributed HFT reading makes repentance change the sanction's reach when it occurs before practical control is acquired.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:34:3:1 is linked by the attributed return-event trace to the before phrase at 5:34:5:1 and the power event at 5:34:7:1; their contact turns the temporal cutoff into a change in how far the sanction reaches.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the exception as a relation-changing turn that arrives before control closes.
findings.containment: This is attributed legacy HFT evidence; it does not replace the local perfect verb or claim an unqualified cancellation after control.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinates and roots match, but the HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound and the trace is retained as attributed.

findings.title: base_closing_encounter

findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:34:3:1 is linked by the attributed cutting trace to the before word at 5:34:5:1 and the power event at 5:34:7:1; facing pressure and narrowing pressure meet the return image and produce a closing sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The temporal phrase gains a second local picture of room for change narrowing as control approaches.
findings.containment: This remains an exploratory attributed image; it does not turn the verse into a literal capture scene or replace the temporal threshold.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinates and roots match, but the HFT record is legacy_unbound and explicitly exploratory.

findings.title: base_epistemic_guardrail
findings.claim: The attributed reading makes the knowledge command discipline the empowered audience under divine protection and mercy.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 5:34:9:2 meets the power event at 5:34:7:1 and the two final attributes at 5:34:12:1 and 5:34:13:1; marking, protective forgiveness, and beneficent mercy place a boundary around how human control is understood.
findings.reader_payoff: The command becomes an instruction about the manner in which power must be interpreted and exercised, not merely consolation for the repentant persons.
findings.containment: This is attributed legacy HFT evidence; it does not deny human legal authority or merge the two divine predicates into one.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus coordinates and roots match, while the HFT reader identity is legacy_unbound and the synthesis is retained as attributed.
